description: This file defines the TaskViewModel class in a Kotlin-based Android application, managing a list of tasks and interactions with a TaskRepository. It utilizes Android's ViewModel and coroutine features to handle task operations asynchronously.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing task data, including adding, updating, toggling completion, deleting tasks, and handling errors.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with the specified title and optional description, updating the task list.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by id with new title and description.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task identified by id.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the task identified by id.
